title: Privacy and digital licences and credentials
summary: This page provides information about the security and privacy measures used when accessing digital licences and credentials through the Service NSW app.
intro: The Service NSW app was designed with a focus on 3 priorities: security, privacy and a great customer experience. The app allows you to check your registrations, fines and demerit points, and access various digital licences and credentials, including the NSW Digital Driver Licence and Digital Photo Card. You can take advantage of these convenient services knowing your private information remains private.

faqs.q: How is my private information kept safe when using the Service NSW app?
faqs.a: The Service NSW app was designed with security and privacy as key priorities, ensuring your private information remains private.

faqs.q: What can I check or access using the Service NSW app?
faqs.a: The app allows you to check your registrations, fines, demerit points, and access various digital licences and credentials, such as the NSW Digital Driver Licence and Digital Photo Card.
